title: NL coast: THE 80 g/h RATE TEST, with dune repeats back on
terrain: firm wet sand and dunes, roughly 300m D+ and 300m D- on soft sand, no packed paths or boardwalks on the descents

steps.target: Z3-Z4 dune climb, 153-166 bpm, power-hike the steep half
walk down the SOFT dry face, then easy flat

coachNotes:
EXECUTION: 8 dune reps, not 10. Power-hike the steep half of each climb. Walk or jog down the SOFT DRY face only, never a packed path, boardwalk or staircase. Turn around every 10-15min so the right leg is not on the low side of the beach camber, or run the flat band above the high tide line. Cadence 165-170 spm on flat and shallow downhill.
GYM: none, the dunes are the strength work.
FUEL, THE RANKED OBJECTIVE OF THE DAY: 80 g/h = 2 Enervit Carbo Gel C2:1 Pro per hour. This is 1h50, so gels at minute 30, 60 and 90, each with 150-250ml water. No SiS gel on top, it is maltodextrin only and breaks the glucose ceiling. Sodium 500-700 mg/h: check the Bulk tub for mg per scoop, it likely needs 2-3 scoops per 500ml. Write down grams, product, and what the stomach did.
STOP RULE: no symptoms during, after, or next day. Calves shouting by rep 5 means stop at 5 and jog the rest flat. If reps and intake conflict, the reps go and the intake stays.
WHY SAND: soft sand strips most of the impact-braking cycle, so this is close to free eccentric exposure 14 days out, in a 14-day window that otherwise has none. 72h post-shockwave the knee may be quieter than it truly is, so 8 is the number.
